parameters.jsCode:
// Generate automated responses based on intent
const data = $input.first().json;
const intent = data.suggestedResponse;

const responses = {
  welcome_message: {
    text: `Hi ${data.userName}! 👋 Thanks for visiting. I'm here to help you find the best insurance coverage at the best price.

What can I help you with today?

• Life Insurance
• Health Insurance
• Get a Quote
• Speak with an Agent`,
    quickReplies: ['Life Insurance', 'Health Insurance', 'Get Quote', 'Talk to Agent']
  },
  
  life_insurance: {
    text: `Great question about life insurance! We offer several types:

**Term Life** - Affordable coverage for a specific period (10, 20, 30 years)
**Whole Life** - Permanent coverage with cash value
**Universal Life** - Flexible premiums and death benefit

Most of our clients save 20-40% by comparing quotes from 20+ carriers.

Would you like to see what you qualify for?`,
    quickReplies: ['Yes, get quote', 'Tell me more', 'Pricing info']
  },
  
  health_insurance: {
    text: `I can help you find health insurance! We work with:

✓ ACA Marketplace Plans
✓ Medicare & Medicaid
✓ Supplemental Coverage
✓ Short-term Health Plans

Rates vary based on your age, location, and needs. Want to see your options?`,
    quickReplies: ['Yes, show options', 'Compare plans', 'Talk to expert']
  },
  
  pricing_info: {
    text: `Great question! Insurance costs depend on several factors:

📊 **For Life Insurance:**
• Your age (younger = lower rates)
• Health status
• Coverage amount needed
• Term length

Average costs:
• 30-year-old: $25-50/month for $500K
• 40-year-old: $40-80/month for $500K

💡 **The best way to get YOUR exact price:** Let me compare quotes from 20+ carriers. Takes 2 minutes!

Ready to see your personalized rates?`,
    quickReplies: ['Yes, get my quote', 'More info first']
  },
  
  coverage_info: {
    text: `Coverage varies by policy type, but here's what's typically included:

**Life Insurance covers:**
✓ Death benefit to beneficiaries
✓ Some policies include living benefits
✓ Cash value accumulation (whole life)

**Health Insurance covers:**
✓ Doctor visits & hospitalizations
✓ Prescription drugs
✓ Preventive care (usually 100%)
✓ Emergency services

Want to discuss YOUR specific needs? I can connect you with a licensed agent who can explain exactly what you'd be covered for.`,
    quickReplies: ['Yes, connect me', 'More questions']
  },
  
  process_explanation: {
    text: `Getting covered is simple! Here's how it works:

**Step 1:** Tell us about your needs (2 minutes)
**Step 2:** We compare 20+ carriers instantly
**Step 3:** Licensed agent reviews best 3-5 options with you (15 min call)
**Step 4:** Choose your coverage
**Step 5:** Complete application
**Step 6:** You're covered! 🎉

Most people are approved within 24-48 hours.

Ready to get started?`,
    quickReplies: ['Yes, let's start', 'Talk to agent first']
  },
  
  capture_lead_info: {
    text: `Perfect! I'll help you get quotes from 20+ top-rated carriers.

To get started, I just need a few quick details:

1️⃣ What's your first name?`,
    quickReplies: [],
    action: 'start_lead_capture'
  }
};

const response = responses[intent] || responses.welcome_message;

return {
  json: {
    ...data,
    botResponse: response.text,
    quickReplies: response.quickReplies,
    action: response.action || 'continue_conversation',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  }
};
